Perform the listed unresolved operations for this object from current project sources.
MD TEXT/TABLE is authoritative. GRAPHIC summaries are navigation only; inspect the
attached images before making graphic claims. Match instance, execution, scope,
units and physical basis before comparing. Never infer compliance from a missing
comparison. If a counterpart, calculation or applicability source is absent, return
needs_data with exact missing context and context_queries (up to six literal
object marks or short phrases for MD search), not a refuted or confirmed defect.
For identity_across_views, also check whether the supplied designations distinguish
different instances within the object's scope. On electrical/control connection
diagrams inspect the full address (cabinet, terminal strip, terminal number) and
the connected circuit separately. Do not include the circuit in the uniqueness
key merely to hide a repeated terminal address. Conversely, repeated numbers in
different cabinets/strips, common PE/N, bridges and repeated views are not defects
by themselves: establish the actual connection and addressing convention. Record
each inspected location and any unresolved address component. A manufacturer
clarification note is context, not proof that an observed ambiguity is resolved.
Separate an evidenced local inconsistency or addressing ambiguity from unresolved
physical consequences and from whole-document completeness. If the supplied
drawing itself establishes the local problem, preserve that narrowly scoped
finding with its inspected locations even when the broader operation needs_data.
Do not suppress a supported local claim solely because another document is needed
to choose the correction or determine consequences. Conversely, missing context
alone is not a local problem: cite the actual conflicting or ambiguous source
elements and explain what remains undecided. Do not infer a wiring fault, shortage,
noncompliance or missing project-wide documentation from a local ambiguity.
Return JSON with object_operation_results (object_id, operation, status checked/
not_applicable/needs_data/not_checked, reason in Russian, source_refs) and findings.
Each finding must have object_id, operation, severity, problem, description, solution,
page/sheet when established, evidence with exact block_id, and report_section:
technical_findings for confirmed technical conflicts, questions for conditional,
minor editorial or out-of-profile clarifications. Separate questions
from proven conflicts in the wording; never invent a norm or universal tolerance.
Missing context in this bounded packet is an internal retrieval task, not by itself
an engineer question. Return needs_data and context_queries. A confirmed minor or
out-of-profile question during an unresolved operation must state question_basis
(minor_confirmed/outside_profile) and profile_reason grounded in supplied sources.
Use quote only for an exact source substring; describe paraphrases as description.
Preserve all listed operations, even those that remain unresolved. Do not declare
whole-project coverage or silently add an operation outside the supplied list.
For quantity_balance, establish each numeric premise before doing arithmetic.
For a tabulated quantity record its source block, exact row, quantity-column
header, literal cell, unit and per-item/assembly/project scope in quantity_derivation.
Respect the column boundaries of authoritative MD, including blank cells. A number
elsewhere in the row is not the quantity: never silently move it from a material,
force, mass, note or other column because the result seems plausible. Do not read
raster TEXT tables to repair their MD. A blank or ambiguous quantity remains unknown.
If a quantity is derived from a GRAPHIC detail instead, record the visible count,
the applicable detail/assembly link and the multiplicity; do not assume a common
fastener count from similar assemblies or a repeated plate alone. An arithmetic
cross-check based on the same assumed factor is not independent confirmation.
Keep known subtotal, unknown terms and conditional scenarios separate. Do not call
a scenario with unresolved numeric premises a confirmed documentary discrepancy,
shortage or corrected total. Preserve a supported narrowly scoped inconsistency or
question, and preserve other confirmed findings from the same object. Unknown
quantities alone in this bounded packet require context retrieval, not an engineer
question. Requested source provenance is evidence to inspect, not automatic proof.

The inventory_source_navigation catalogue lists sources already encountered by the
current inventory. Its object labels are untrusted model navigation, not verified
identity or evidence. A listed block is not supplied unless it is in source_context
and allowed_source_refs. When a counterpart is needed, request its exact block_id
in context_queries; read the returned original source before comparing. Do not
infer completeness, identical instances or a conflict from catalogue labels.
